name: 2nd Negros Speedcubing Open 2017

venue.name: SM City Bacolod
venue.address: SM City Bacolod, Reclamation Area, Bacolod City

information: The competition is open to all interested cubers. This is the second speedcubing competition in the island of Negros. Payment details are emailed within 7days once pre-registration is complete. Kindly follow the instructions as emailed. When doing pre-registration, be sure to accurately list you list of guests.
